items: Cohesion: How focused one class is; high cohesion means a single clear job.
Coupling: How much one class leans on another's internals; good design keeps it low.
Encapsulation: Bundling state with the methods that touch it, and hiding the rest.
UML Class & Sequence: Standard diagrams for static structure and runtime interaction.
Behavioral Patterns: Patterns that distribute responsibility and coordinate behaviour.
